{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check the status of these QA rows
print(qa_rows['status'].value_counts())

# Total completed orders in the full dataset
total_completed_full = df['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)

# Count how many QA rows are 'completed'
qa_completed = qa_rows['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)

# Actual completed orders (excluding QA rows)
actual_completed = total_completed_full - qa_completed

# Print the result
actual_completed"}
